rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI with a conviction that personal AI agents need brain-inspired memory systems, privacy, and local-first architecture—exactly the kind of sophisticated agent foundation that Georgi's GTM automation platform at Rilo could integrate to move beyond task-based workflows toward truly agentic outcomes. Both are hands-on founders shipping AI agent infrastructure (Steven on the consumer/memory layer, Georgi on the workflow/automation layer), and Georgi explicitly needs to showcase Rilo to builder communities like this hackathon—Steven's technical credibility in AI and DeFi could be a valuable early validator and potential integration partner.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Georgi—you're both building next-gen AI agent systems from first principles, and Georgi's GTM automation platform could be a natural fit for showcasing Steven's brain-inspired memory architecture to early-stage teams.
